business_process: Physical access control and tenant credentialing
description: Door and turnstile access for tenants and staff; issuing and revoking badges; after-hours access schedules
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Doors must lock and unlock on schedule and let people out safely; door controllers cache credentials for up to 72 hours but no badge can be issued or revoked while the platform or network is down; a revoked badge that still works is a physical security exposure
manual_workaround: Guards post at main entrances with printed tenant lists; doors set to scheduled lock mode; badge changes queued on paper
dependent_third_parties: Access control platform vendor; access control and video integrator; ISPs
dependent_people_or_facilities: Security Manager; security console operators; all three properties

description: Supervisory control and alarm handling for chillers, air handlers, VAV boxes, lighting schedules, and meters through the BAS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Field controllers keep running last programs, but nobody can change setpoints, answer equipment alarms, or run after-hours HVAC; Florida heat makes tenant spaces and tenant server rooms unusable within a day; leases allow rent abatement if premises are untenantable for more than 5 consecutive business days (about $56K revenue per day across the portfolio); RPO 24 h matches the rate of program changes, but today's weekly image cannot meet it
manual_workaround: Chief engineers switch plant equipment to local hand control and do hourly manual rounds; portable cooling for tenant server rooms; lighting on local switches
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-04; SYS-08 (historian and backups); SYS-09 (engineering workstations)
dependent_third_parties: BAS integrator; equipment service contractors; ISPs
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Engineering; chief engineers; engineering staff at all properties

description: Building notices to tenants, incident updates, and service interruption notices required by leases
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tenants must be told about outages and incidents promptly; some leases set 72-hour notice for access control data incidents; poor communication drives abatement claims and non-renewals
manual_workaround: Phone tree to tenant contacts from a printed list kept by each Property Manager; lobby signage
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; property management system vendor; phone carrier

description: Live monitoring at the security console, recording, incident review, and video requests from police and tenants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Loss of video removes deterrence and evidence; guards can patrol instead; 30-day retention on NVRs
manual_workaround: Increase guard patrols; security console uses door event feed only
dependent_third_parties: Access control and video integrator; guard service

business_process: Engineering work orders and tenant service requests
description: Tenant requests, preventive maintenance, and after-hours HVAC requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Requests can be taken by phone; preventive maintenance can slip a few days
manual_workaround: Paper work order forms and phone requests to the management office

description: Registering visitors, printing passes, and checking ID at the lobby
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Lobby can run on a paper log with a guard checking ID; a long outage slows entry for about 150 visitors a day
manual_workaround: Paper visitor log and guard escort; tenants pre-register by email

business_process: Rent billing, collections, and tenant accounting
description: Monthly rent and recovery invoices, ACH collection, receivables, and payables
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1.7M billed each month, mostly collected in the first 5 business days; a delay at month start hurts cash flow; vendor-hosted with its own backups
manual_workaround: Invoice from the last month's register; tenants pay by bank transfer; line of credit

business_process: Card payment acceptance at the management offices
description: Conference-center and event bookings, after-hours HVAC charges, badge fees, kiosk license fees
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 2,100 card transactions a year; customers can pay by invoice or ACH
manual_workaround: Invoice the customer; take payment later on a working terminal (never on paper)

description: Prospect tours, lease drafting, critical dates, and lease abstracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No same-day dependency; lease critical dates are tracked monthly
manual_workaround: Work from signed lease copies in cloud file storage

description: Time capture, biweekly payroll, onboarding and termination
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; a missed payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider
